tasks.title: Registry HTTP static-first design contract

outputs.observable: discovery, root, timestamp, object, package, channel and evidence records with bounded fields
equivalent HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2 and HTTP/3 fixtures with HTTPS and explicit-local cases
search index reconstructed only from checkpoint and immutable catalog pages without authority
sequence, channel, yank, deprecation and revocation decisions anchored in trusted checkpoint
targets, snapshot, timestamp, expiry, download and archive remain explicit implementation-evidence gaps
W-owned deterministic CBOR payload uses role-specific DSSE; external in-toto/SLSA JSON remains JSON inside DSSE
short-lived read capability or signed URL is scoped by object, package, audience and expiry and is not authority
private download policy distinguishes 401, 403 and 404 outcomes
mirror serves matching digest bytes without gaining package authority or private-download scope

adversarialCases.expected: reject transport-specific semantics
search result cannot grant authority or alter lock
reject rollback against trusted checkpoint even when the server counter appears monotonic
reject changed immutable release bytes
reject unlisted mirror as authority
reject missing append-only catalog page
channel convenience cannot replace lock and release verification
reject missing explicit clock/provider or monotonic timestamp persistence
keep download and archive behavior outside the current implementation claim
reject duplicate keys in strict UTF-8 JSON
reject JSON or alternate bytes as W authority; deterministic CBOR is selected
token or signed URL grants only scoped access and never package authority
return the selected 401, 403 or 404 privacy outcome without leaking private existence
mirror cannot widen object, package, audience or expiry scope

tasks.stopCondition: Pare quando schemas, strict JSON, bounds, transport equivalence, trusted-root/checkpoint rollback, catalog reconstruction, private access modes, selected CBOR/DSSE payload and all adversarial cases have observable design results. Não promova um registry implementado.

tasks.title: Closed-source publication through ephemeral CI

outputs.observable: signed intent binds source authority, recipe, target, policy and final digest scope
short-lived GitHub OIDC assertion validates iss, aud, sub, repository, ref, sha and pinned job_workflow_ref without assuming one-use
W service emits a one-use, short-lived, scoped publication capability after OIDC validation
artifact, builder, test and security attestations use role-specific DSSE; in-toto Statement v1 and SLSA provenance v1.2 remain JSON payloads
maintainer or separate automation authorizes exact final digests
publicSource, sourceClosedBinary and private package remain separate
builder image, toolchain and actions are pinned to digests or revisions
egress is minimized after source acquisition and each permitted destination is recorded
logs, artifacts, caches and diagnostics redact source and secret material
secret issuance, use, revocation and cleanup have bounded receipts
CI provider and runner identity are recorded separately from maintainer and builder authorities

adversarialCases.expected: reject stale or replayed OIDC assertion according to issuer, audience, subject, workflow and ref validation
reject reuse of the W one-use publication capability
reject source, package or digest scope expansion
registry is not required to receive source
reject builder signing with maintainer private key
reject publication without final authorization
do not convert provider claim into physical discard proof
separate authorized reproduction from independent public reproduction
fail without source fallback
reject unpinned action that can exfiltrate source
redact source and secrets from logs and diagnostics
redact or scope artifact and cache outputs
do not expose publication secrets to fork or pull-request execution
reject issuer, audience, subject, workflow or ref mismatch

tasks.stopCondition: Pare quando intent, OIDC assertion validation, one-use W publication capability, source acquisition, pinned CI threat outputs, attestations, final authorization, visibility states e todos os cases de replay, leakage ou authority tiverem outputs observáveis. Não alegue descarte físico, source confidentiality ou reprodução pública.

tasks.title: Bounded binary capsule and artifact family

outputs.observable: target/profile/toolchain capsule has a root digest and bounded index that reference internal chunks by digest
ExecutionDescriptor records entrypoints, requirements, sandbox profile and payload refs
WInterface, WMeta, WAbi, native objects, symbols, requirements and allowed summaries
HIR, MLIR or LLVM bitcode requires exact toolchain key
target, profile and toolchain-plan row select an artifact family
debug maps, source maps, SBOM and evidence remain sidecars or referrers
section and chunk fingerprints treat relocation and ASLR without raw in-memory hashing
source rebuild versus exact capsule reuse/link measures compile time, cache granularity, storage and network

adversarialCases.expected: reject unbounded or cyclic capsule index
reject absent digest-referenced chunk
reject bytes that do not match chunk digest
reject IR from another exact toolchain key
reject artifact family that hides target/profile/toolchain identity
keep dynamic recipe separate from static capsule
reject mismatch without source fallback
detect or reject modified executable page under the selected platform and provider policy
require explicit policy and evidence for self-modifying code or JIT
do not claim raw in-memory equality when relocation or ASLR changes addresses

tasks.stopCondition: Pare quando capsule schema, ExecutionDescriptor, bounds, chunk classes, toolchain gate, artifact family, sidecars, relocation measurements, source-versus-capsule benchmark e todos os modified-page, JIT e mismatch cases tiverem outputs observáveis. O objetivo é provar redução de compile time. Não promova uma universal binary ou uma nova ABI W.

tasks.title: Test descriptor, evidence key and separated lanes

outputs.observable: @example, w test, colocated test and *.test.w map to TestDescriptor and TestPlan
stable ID, owner declaration, origin carrier, source map, kind, fixtures/effects, oracle or expected diagnostic/outcome, target/profile, seed/limits and body/plan digest are required
source, release, artifact, plan, analyzer, recipe, toolchain, target and profile keys plus seed, limits and outcome
unit, compile-fail, property/fuzz, simulation, provider, fault and performance remain distinct; simulation is not provider evidence
subject digest points to immutable attestation objects and axis facts
stale evidence and advisory changes produce new projections without rewriting attestations

adversarialCases.expected: reject effectful test without explicit fixture
reject simulation as real-provider evidence
reject one aggregate lane for unit, fuzz, provider and fault evidence
reject property or fuzz evidence without seed and limits
append a projection instead of mutating the attestation
reject aggregated safe badge
keep documentation tests out of release payload
record async and cancellation behavior in the descriptor and evidence lane
bind snapshot or golden identity to source, plan, target and profile digests

tasks.stopCondition: Pare quando os quatro carriers, complete TestDescriptor/TestPlan fields, evidence key, lane matrix, async/cancellation and snapshot/golden vectors, subject projection, freshness vectors e todos os cases de fixture ou aggregation tiverem resultados observáveis. Não produza safe badge.

tasks.title: Continuous security and advisory evidence

outputs.observable: immutable security attestation is keyed by artifact, analyzer identity and version, policy, corpus-or-database digest, target and profile
SBOM, RuntimeClosure and reachability facts are linked to the exact artifact and target/profile
advisory match identifies package, version, target, profile and artifact
analyzer or database changes append a new reevaluation snapshot without rewriting attestations
portal exposes security facts by axis and freshness without an aggregate safe badge
conflicting analyzer identities, versions, policies and outcomes remain separate facts

adversarialCases.expected: record valid digest bytes as malicious evidence when analyzer policy identifies them
mark stale analyzer evidence and do not treat it as current
append reevaluation after a CVE or advisory database update
record a newly disclosed rule or signature without claiming knowledge before disclosure
match vulnerability only to affected target/profile and artifact scope
distinguish a resolved dependency from reachable or shipped code
preserve conflicting analyzer results instead of selecting a hidden winner
carry revoked or yanked state into the security projection without rewriting the artifact
record binary-only scan limits and do not infer source or build provenance
reject an aggregate safe badge in portal or registry projection

tasks.stopCondition: Pare quando security attestation, SBOM/RuntimeClosure/reachability, advisory match, reevaluation snapshot, portal axis/freshness e conflicting-analyzer record tiverem resultados observáveis e todos os cases forem avaliados. Não alegue conhecimento prévio de zero-days nem produza safe badge agregado.

tasks.title: Provider/profile sandbox enforcement

outputs.observable: capability and effect plan maps to provider-specific controls
seccomp allowlist plus namespaces, credentials, filesystem, network and resource controls
Windows, macOS and WASI equivalents preserve explicit admission facts
provider enforcement completes before loader and user code; missing receipt is unsupported with no fallback
audit or learn mode is suggestion-only and never an enforcement receipt

adversarialCases.expected: reject seccomp without namespaces, credentials and policy controls
reject denylist as adversarial baseline
reject LD_PRELOAD as isolation
reject ptrace or CAP_SYS_ADMIN wrapper as baseline
reject same-process native plugin
learn mode cannot satisfy enforcement receipt
reject user code before provider enforcement
reject resource or capability expansion at deployment

tasks.stopCondition: Pare quando plan, provider profiles, pre-user-code ordering, learn-mode separation e todos os bypass cases tiverem provider receipts e negative results. Não alegue isolamento adversarial.

tasks.title: Signed remote runner with explicit admission

outputs.observable: registry package version resolves to exact lock, release, artifact and digest for w run
authorization, registry admission, freshness, revocation and consumer policy facts
native code starts in child process or compartment after enforcement
unsigned local source is allowed only by explicit local debug policy
deployment-owned reproduction, evidence, advisory and capability requirements

adversarialCases.expected: reject non-exact resolution
reject payload digest mismatch
block install or execution
allow configured trusted roots and reject single-root assumption
signature cannot grant capability
reject baseline same-process native loading
reject remote ad-hoc execution without sandbox admission
channel document cannot replace lock or release verification

tasks.stopCondition: Pare quando exact resolution, admission, freshness, revocation, local debug policy, child-process launch, consumer policy e todos os bypass cases tiverem outputs observáveis. Não anuncie CLI ou runner disponível.

tasks.title: Opaque entitlement or lease capability

outputs.observable: product, feature, audience and expiry are bound without raw token in app API
online and offline validation rules have explicit expiry and revocation behavior
provider owns opaque entitlement material and app receives only capability result, never a raw token
expired, revoked, audience-mismatch and product-mismatch decisions
tamper, replay, offline and provider compromise limits are explicit

adversarialCases.expected: reject raw entitlement token in app API
reject scope mismatch
reject expired lease under offline policy
reject lease without bounded expiry or renewal policy
reject provider identity as entitlement authority without scope
reject replayed revoked lease when policy requires online check
record residual risk and reject inviolable DRM claim

tasks.stopCondition: Pare quando lease schema, online/offline policy, redaction boundary, expiry/revocation vectors e residual risk tiverem outputs observáveis. Não prometa DRM inviolável.

witnesses.scenario: A closed-source last-light/menu-compiler package presents a release intent, uses two authorized builders, emits one WEC capsule per target, runs doctests and fuzz lanes, publishes security evidence, applies append-only update and deprecation metadata, revokes a release, rebuilds search from trusted objects, and attempts w run registry:last-light/restaurant@0.1.0 --product last-light-native in a sandbox without network by default with optional entitlement.

outputs.observable: one bounded report traverses all eight tasks in dependency order and names every source, digest, target, profile and policy boundary
known identity, private read capability, trusted checkpoint, catalog search rebuild and channel convenience remain separate
release intent, two builders, per-target capsules, test/security attestations, update, deprecation and revocation are linked by digest
exact w run resolution reaches child-process sandbox with network denied by default and optional opaque entitlement

adversarialCases.expected: fixture reaches RDX0, PCB0, WEC0, TEV0, SEV0, SBX0, RSX0 and ENT0 without claiming implementation
OIDC assertion replay is distinct from W publication capability reuse and scope escalation
target-specific capsules and doctest, fuzz and security evidence cannot be substituted across target or profile
deprecation/update, revocation and search rebuild append metadata and never rewrite release or attestation
w run is sandboxed with network denied by default and entitlement remains optional, scoped and opaque

completion.promotionRule: Uma revisão futura do schema e do checker pode promover somente uma implementação após evidence independente suficiente; o oracle atual fecha design e não prova crypto, server, provider ou runner.
completion.stopCondition: Pare o bundle quando cada task satisfizer sua stop condition, o witness passar, o checker passar e a revisão Sol confirmar que nenhum output virou implementação.

nonClaims: Este ledger não implementa registry, compiler, runtime, runner, provider ou sandbox.
Este ledger não prova descarte físico do source.
Este ledger não prova conformance, isolamento, reprodução pública ou DRM inviolável.
Uma assertion OIDC curta é prova da identity do workflow, não credencial W de uso único; somente a capability W de publicação pode ter one-use explícito.
Ephemeral CI, provider identity ou billing não provam source confidentiality nem tornam GitHub gratuito suficiente para source fechado.
Este ledger não prova crypto, server, provider, runner, clock/freshness ou attestation verifier, e não alega conhecer zero-days antes da divulgação.
